metric_notes.timeline: ms on the source clip's speech timeline; 100 ms chunks of 16 kHz PCM sent in real time, each when it ends (as a mic delivers it)
metric_notes.speech_end: end of the sentence's speech found from the audio (last 20 ms frame >= 20% of the sentence's p90 loudness)
metric_notes.stop_to_first_audio_ms: speech end -> first VOICED sample of that sentence's translation, played on arrival (negative = it began speaking before the speaker finished)
metric_notes.stop_to_first_audio_played_ms: the same through one sequential player, i.e. also waiting for earlier translation still playing
metric_notes.stop_to_tail_audio_ms: pipelines only: speech end -> first voiced audio of the segment holding the sentence's last words (Azure ends segments on 150 ms pauses, so some sentences arrive in pieces)
metric_notes.stop_to_first_text_ms: speech end -> first caption text for that sentence
metric_notes.stop_to_final_text_ms: speech end -> last caption text for that sentence
metric_notes.start_to_first_audio_ms: speech start -> first voiced translated audio of that sentence
metric_notes.stop_to_audio_end_ms: speech end -> end of that sentence's translated speech, its own audio played through from its first sample (nothing earlier queued)
metric_notes.speaks_mid_sentence: true when >= 25% of sentences' first translated audio arrives before the speaker finished the sentence (mid_sentence_share gives the share)
metric_notes.pooling: one run of each condition x route x pair, 15 sentences; sentences with no audio are left out of the audio percentiles (n_with_audio) and score 0 in quality
metric_notes.quality: gemini-3.5-flash (temperature 0) grades each sentence 0-3 against source + reference; Gemini grading Gemini outputs may favour them; ht-en references are model-made (Gemini 2.5 Pro), every direction has a reference: FLoRes text of the target language (ht-en: the model-made English meanings)
metric_notes.split_share: pipelines only: share of sentences that reached the listener as more than one segment
metric_notes.condition: audio condition of the source clip, see README (clean, room-mic, noise-10dB, bt-narrowband, hall-reverb); speech bounds always from the clean clip
metric_notes.quality.partial: judge (gemini-3.5-flash): output present but a meaningful part of the source (clause, name, number, qualifier) absent
metric_notes.quality.duplicates: judge (gemini-3.5-flash): output says some content twice
metric_notes.sources: omni-stt routes: delivered segments by the final they came from (Azure's vs omni-stt's), and sentences delivered from both
metric_notes.last_words: stop_to_tail_audio_ms for pipelines; for gemini-lt (streaming) the README table uses stop_to_audio_end_ms instead (no segment boundary)
